name: @ros-chromium/nodes
description: LocalBus nodes (roadmap.md Phase 7). TeleopNode (Gamepad API polling -> bus). PlannerNode (grid A*/Hybrid A* via @ros-chromium/planner-wasm). OdometryNode + PoseFusionNode (encoder ?C dead-reckoning + Kalman correction, replacing robot_localization's EKF). PathFollowerNode (pure pursuit). MapNode (LIDAR scan + pose -> occupancy grid in pathfinder's NewGridFromOccupancy shape). SafetyMonitorNode is still TODO. None run in their own Web Worker yet — see plan.md.
